entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 serves as a universal memory layer for AI agents, providing multi-level state management for users, sessions, and agents. Available as a managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted service, it utilizes temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval to maintain persistent context.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: This open-source context database organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading architecture. It achieves significant token reduction and task-completion gains by archiving sessions through background extraction and compilation.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine designed to give AI agents persistent long-term memory across multiple sessions. It builds these graphs from text and code while supporting custom data models and ontologies for domain-specific grounding.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication for prompt-cache efficiency. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, videos, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain provides synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis for multi-user company setups with scoped data access. It uniquely creates knowledge graphs with typed edges without requiring LLM calls for the construction process.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a 'learn, retain, recall, and reflect' workflow to provide agents with evolving long-term memory. It is compatible with over 25 LLM providers and offers deployment flexibility via Docker, Kubernetes, and multiple language clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library that enables stateful agents through background reasoning that updates peer representations from session history. It supports managed, local, or self-hosted deployments and serves as the upstream library for specialized Hermes wrappers.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, ensuring sub-100ms response times.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that relies on a single SQLite database and one pure-Python dependency for sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth as the memory corpus expands.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os utilizes a seven-layer system including vector search on Qdrant and structured facts to manage agent context. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context over other data sources.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving harness generates filesystem-first artifacts like context bundles and traces to assist agents with complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion, where context changes are only finalized based on verified trial results.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes-lcm is a lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) and SQLite to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep to help agents recover specific details from persistent message stores.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from over 20 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over months of past data. It utilizes MCP recall for high-speed searches across gigabytes of history while redacting keys and tokens for safety.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider to maintain persistent state across sessions.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur implements a shared memory layer using a human-readable YAML engram format for multi-agent systems. It employs hybrid BM25 and embedding-based retrieval to inject context across global, team, and project-specific scopes.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer achieves 97.6% accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks for portable state across multiple agent clients. It automates memory construction from diverse sources including Discord, Obsidian, and office documents.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and specific agent hooks, utilizing hybrid retrieval that combines BM25 and vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This five-package plugin family provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a SQLite-backed hierarchical schema. It distinguishes itself by requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models, relying instead on FTS5 search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse in agentic ecosystems. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens while maintaining inference accuracy.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every result. It manages the memory lifecycle through contradiction tracking and hygiene passes, supporting both embedded and HTTP backend execution.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI serves as a machine interface for agent-driven knowledge maintenance without the use of vector databases. It preserves citations and temporal memory while supporting portable archives for merging data between different stores.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs in real-time. It utilizes local-first storage with SQLite-vec and GGUF models to provide an MCP-native server for major coding clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory kernel for the Hermes agent. It manages state and retrieval through SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver a purpose-built evidence packet for every query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory layer resolves live workspace states into verified context files to reduce prompt token usage by 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text retrieval, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces schema overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords. It includes a dedicated dashboard to track estimated token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals and receipts. It offers a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents across different platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance ranking. It combines BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin enables immediate event deletion and uses an on-demand summarizer to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK and MCP server that allows agents to manage budget-bound wallets for x402 payments. It supports USDC and stablecoins across EVM and Solana chains without requiring a backend or API keys.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local artifacts such as scripts, cron jobs, and documentation to facilitate capability routing. It registers five native tools for searching and reporting artifact usage while automatically generating tool routing notes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo offers durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It relies on a local SQLite layer and write outbox to ensure reliability when searching or updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking during retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic search and grounded Q&A via a local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for structured file reads and synchronization.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB offers AI-native long-term memory featuring AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and HNSW ANN retrieval. It supports multiple execution modes, including native Rust FFI, and utilizes MinHash deduplication alongside sparse and exact-text recall.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression, making it suitable for complex relational data retrieval.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This tool focuses on memory hygiene through a file-based system that uses a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown storage without requiring a database. It utilizes five slash commands and dedicated curators to identify 'rot' or contradictions, proposing evidence-cited updates for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology centered on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates the transition from spec elicitation to implementation planning while supporting various coding harnesses and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime. It allows agents to export designs into multiple formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to bolster defensive and offensive security capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool enables agents to convert codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language. It supports incremental synchronization, ensuring that manual layout adjustments are preserved during updates.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and a dedicated layer for verification and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass editing process. It features Rewrite, Detect, and Edit-in-place modes with customizable voice profiles for professional or technical contexts.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions for Hermes and other compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder to ensure persistence.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 1,174 professional skills distributed as human-readable markdown files under the MIT license. These skills are designed to run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code with ready-to-paste exports for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows agents to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlists from YouTube. It integrates with Hermes Agent and Cursor, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds to streamline the creation of new agent capabilities.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original literate document.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first, Git-based harness for long-running agents that operates without a background service. It utilizes a three-layer system of kernels, plugins, and recipes to implement the SLP cooperative-agent protocol.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides and skills in the SKILL.md format specifically for Portuguese-speaking users. It maintains compatibility with the agentskills.io standard for seamless integration.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams. These skills are installable via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI for oracle network integration.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. It offers specific prompting guidelines and a dedicated FLUX 3 video suite.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It features automated workflows for briefing, testing, and exporting skills while linking instructions to specific file lines.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers a Python client and CLI for installing reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features through the use of TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that uses four core verbs—infer, invoke, exec, and agent—to define intent as code. It records execution traces and journals locally and is compatible with macOS and Linux.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks with autonomous execution and real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It features a guided setup script for credential validation and ensures secure communication via HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and includes graceful degradation for environments missing specific dependencies.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as a personal execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive scheduling, habits, and study blocks. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill utilizes three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple surfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage per rewrite. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes an approval gate for managing simplification risks.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and reproduction through multi-story task decomposition. It implements mandatory evidence-based verification gates and uses a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to address CVE-driven scenarios from 2015 through 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite adds session management and worktree recovery tools to provide memory and state drift detection between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for new skill development.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs covering token costs, session health, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and includes an optional script for incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts with vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding optimized files under 8 MB directly into README markdown.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables terminal-based searching of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills for integration with clients like Hermes and Cursor. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins and tools indexed on remoteopenclaw.com.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specifications to detect and report drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It uses a combination of deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators to gate skill updates and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: Designed for cross-environment compatibility, this project handles deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies existing project-compatible runtimes without new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and integrates with OpenClaw and Hermes Agent for financial transactions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for Chinese language processing, including Douyin video transcription to Markdown and rule-based removal of common AI writing patterns. It also features macOS-based OCR for structured data extraction and an e-commerce material studio.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the functional quality of agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with payments distributed to dedicated wallet keys upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools via an MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, and other AI agents.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It uses semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests and produces structured analysis featuring core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This project provides agents with practical capabilities including live social data access, company enrichment, and CRM management through a workspace Postgres. It supports integration with Claude Code and Cursor while offering an MCP server for automated configuration across compatible clients.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI-powered coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both open-source and unfree licensed tools. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to ensure users have access to the latest versions.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and other CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool utilizes a proot-distro Ubuntu environment to install Hermes Agent on Android devices through an automated Termux script. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and integration with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community-driven Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and allows for the scheduling of tasks using cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell to restrict network and filesystem access at the kernel level. Users can define specific security policies to govern the agent's messaging capabilities and web search activities.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using Helm charts. It features a comprehensive credential catalog, integrations for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and supports persistent state through mounted home directories. It allows users to build specific Hermes versions by utilizing build arguments during the image creation process.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository offers a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployments using declarative configurations for workspaces and settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane that manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes Agent to run from a USB drive or any external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized agents for technical, fundamental, and sentiment analysis to execute financial trading strategies. It ensures point-in-time data integrity during backtesting and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a Web UI or CLI. It supports local Node.js installation or Docker deployment, offering memory browsing and MCP server integration for workflow management.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages coding agents like Hermes and Claude using persistent tmux sessions for background execution and container-based isolation. It provides a TUI and web dashboard for overseeing Git worktree management and multi-agent coordination.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features HTTP signal detection to manage payment-required states for paid APIs across specialist teams.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes from single VPS agents to automated teams via a task bus delegation pattern. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It integrates with over 23 LLM providers and supports MCP tools to extend agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous tasks and a live stream of agent reasoning. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure quality and implementation standards.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via a dedicated Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization tool automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena-style framework orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution, visualizing the competition through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It leverages Ollama for parallel model querying and synthesis without relying on cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a 100% local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It supports cross-file resolution for TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust, integrating with agents like Hermes via an MCP server.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents and IDEs, including Hermes and Claude Code. It offers a terminal user interface and a 3D visualization dashboard to monitor consumption and participate in public leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from coding agents like Hermes, Codex, and Gemini. It ensures security by redacting authentication headers and provides a self-contained HTML viewer for analyzing exported trace sessions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and 37+ other AI tools directly. It supports multi-device synchronization to maintain consistent usage data across different machines.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help developers build better interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown, including Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and ship applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes and ASCII art. Using YAML-based configurations, developers can apply diverse aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk styles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent commerce through Solana-based payments and identity registration using human-readable handles.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and provides built-in integration for providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It enables persistent memory across chat platforms including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and finance, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and custom instructions.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static analysis tool performs deterministic linting of agent configurations and system prompts without requiring runtime model execution. It identifies ambiguous descriptions and contract mismatches, integrating directly into CI workflows via GitHub Actions or pre-commit hooks.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This utility automates the installation of a full hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool facilitates the transition from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by converting SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible formats. It maps existing configurations into Hermes YAML and JSON while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local configuration changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project provides a deterministic local runtime designed for executing commercial opportunities with Hermes Agent. It enforces a security model requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions through specific contract types.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides an offline, open-mic interface for Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in capabilities without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a dedicated circuit breaker for API outages and provides tools for the management and retrieval of agent memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It centralizes configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside other command-line tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi serves as a local coworking application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities. It enables 24/7 automation via Cron and supports remote access through a WebUI or various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote connections through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one place.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard facilitates multi-platform channel configuration for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It offers visual workflow building with human approval gates, scheduling, and detailed analytics for tracking token costs and model distribution.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and dedicated managers for memory, skills, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It includes fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a specialized kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports memory management and renders complex content like LaTeX and Markdown.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension links active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes. It allows users to toggle specific tabs for agent context and supports multi-agent group chats with synced conversation histories.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that connects directly to a self-hosted server without third-party relays. It enables mobile management of agent chats, scheduled tasks, skills, and server-side files.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session quota burn and estimated API costs across 15 agents. It allows users to search local prompts and tool calls while providing the ability to resume supported CLI sessions in Terminal, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the administration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile-first dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via embedded Python and Node.js runtimes without requiring installation or admin rights. It features a Tkinter GUI and includes 100 tools for tasks such as TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
